title: Team Chat — LLP 0063 Step 6 pressure app
description: A local non-claiming Slack/Discord-shaped kernel that exercises protected rooms, membership changes, bounded recipient fan-out, unread state, keyset-paged inbox delivery, and leave-time revocation.

backend.stalenessPolicy: committed; regenerate with codegen; freshness tracked by artifacts.json inputsHash

headlessLocalPressure: room bootstrap atomically seats the owner
an invitation does not grant room visibility until self-accept
a 32-recipient message fan-out commits one message and one private inbox row per active participant
unread state is recipient-owned, live, and clearable by room
opaque keyset cursors page a recipient inbox without overlap
self-leave revokes protected room reads and purges that room from the former member's inbox

capabilityGaps: hosted auth and trusted-single-tenant operations under LLP 0072
complete React and Contract product UI
notClaiming: host removal of another member; the current accepted membership surface exposes self-leave but no application-reachable private roster id
